name: Opening range — Treasury bonds 1-hour (Month 10 Core)

definitions.definition_text: Bond-market opening range begins at 8:00 a.m. New York time and ends 9:00 a.m. New York time. Narrow focus: the opening range between 8:00 and 9:00 tends to create the bond market high or low of the day — run-on stops or a fair value setup (bullish/bearish order block).
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY bond session; Month 10 Core Content bond OR = 8:00–9:00 (1h)
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from index 9:30–10:30 OR and from modern NY equity-index 30m OR. Same Month 10 series, different asset clock.

source.title: ICT Mentorship Core Content - Month 10 - Bond Trading - Basics & Opening Range Concept

definitions.definition_text: Highest volume is seen between 8:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m. New York time. True day for the bond market is 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. New York time.
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Bond true day 08:00–15:00 NY; volume surge spans into 9:30
definitions.variations_note: Volume window (8:00–9:30) is wider than the 1h OR (8:00–9:00) — parallel nuance to index lecture's 30m volume surge vs 1h OR.

source.title: ICT Mentorship Core Content - Month 10 - Bond Trading - Basics & Opening Range Concept

definitions.definition_text: Analysis on the New York session for Treasury bond begins at 8:20 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. New York time (contract delivery months noted for 30-year).
conditions: NY session analysis window stated as 8:20–15:00
definitions.timeframe_session_context: Bond NY session analysis start 8:20 vs true-day start 8:00
definitions.variations_note: KEEP SEPARATE from true-day 8:00–15:00 and OR 8:00–9:00 — three distinct clocks in same lecture (analysis start / true day / OR).

source.title: ICT Mentorship Core Content - Month 10 - Bond Trading - Basics & Opening Range Concept

definitions.definition_text: Opening range high/low between the 8:00–9:00 delineations; example trades down below the low formed between 8:00 and 9:00 as a stop run and potential setup.
conditions: Break beyond OR low framed as stop run
definitions.variations_note: Use-case example reinforcing HOD/LOD OR geometry — not a different clock.
